title: Vinyl Turntable Needle-Drop & Acoustic Micro-Groove Shaders: Tactile Tonearm Weight, Vinyl Dust Crackle, 33⅓ RPM Stroboscopic Dynamics & Swiss Audio-Editorial Architecture

Top-down macro close-up of a 33 1/3 RPM vinyl record platter rim with stroboscopic calibration dots freezing under neon light pulses, ultra-sharp contrast, Swiss modernist typography engraved on metal faceplate, hyper-detailed, depth of field.

motion_blueprints.description: Simulating two-axis tonearm pivot physics: smooth horizontal panning arc across record bands (radius 70mm to 145mm) and dampened vertical cueing lever descent with mechanical contact vibration.
